finding.classification: source-confirmed product defect and missing discriminating SDK oracle; not a measured failing runtime
finding.title: Listen hydration return and non-default decision eligibility can bypass use-time consent
evidence: hydrate retains its original DecisionSet; deliver may replace only its local parameter with null because consent is expired/refused. hydrate then returns the original set if intent, delivery and grant remain current, without checking eligibility again.

Reachable schedule: a current grant carries a choice nearing its original deadline; a valid personalized snapshot passes getJson's consentEpoch check, then awaits saveRefusal's shared lock. Choice expiry while waiting need not change grant/generation or hydrate intent (current may still be null). getJson does not recheck consentEpoch after that await. deliver suppresses the private set but returns its new delivery number; hydrate's existing final condition still succeeds. A blocked timer/use-time clock crossing is another source path. No 30-day HTTP request or expired shopper grant is required.

permitted uses only affinity strategy/nonempty drivers and ignores a declared non-default arm. Direct apply, hydrate and cached reads can therefore expose a non-default set that core.emit/socket would reject. This is not a claim that tenant pins are inherently private: content/decide.ts:75–77 explicitly permits pins in default content. A concrete non-default case is visitor-keyed exploration (content/decide.ts:203–211; learn/explore.ts:87–112) reordering zero-score candidates; contentCompose.ts:275–283 and 303–309 still label those pieces default with empty drivers.

Both shipped bundles contain the same branches. Existing new-group tests cover core decisions callbacks/expiry but do not assert the hydrate Promise return after this await, or the non-default/empty-driver direct and cached listen paths.

The core.test.ts W05.10 expiry case creates source createListen(core) for each source/IIFE/ESM core factory, never seeds a private DecisionSet, and delivers an EngineUpdate rather than a decisions set. Its listen.current() === null assertion therefore establishes neither populated private-cache expiry nor the bundled listen implementation. Use the full shipped client factories and a genuinely populated cache in the bounded regression.
finding.minimum_correction: Use one consent-aware decision-set eligibility rule at all listen publication/callback/cache/return boundaries, including a final hydration result check after awaits and callbacks. A declared non-default set must not become safe merely because individual pieces lack affinity drivers. Preserve genuinely default hydration, including tenant-pinned defaults, and existing generation/intent/lease protections. Regenerate both existing bundles.
finding.minimum_checks: In the existing SDK fixture/factories, assert the actual hydrate result, current(), slot/set callbacks and later subscriber against a current grant with a near-expiry carried instruction and delayed snapshot/refusal-lock completion. Add non-default sets with default/empty-driver pieces through hydrate/apply/cache plus genuinely default/pinned positive controls. Exercise source and both shipped clients, not only a bundled core paired with source createListen. Lead admits any rework ownership/checks; no extra reproduction was run here.
